messages:
Alex: New issue: org-scoped API keys are being routed to tenant-specific pools, but quotas/billing and telemetry still attach to token.owner_project — results in double counting and weird dashboards. Anyone seen this?

Maria: I saw that. It's because our routing policy uses `routing_hint` (derived from org->preferred_pool) but telemetry uses `token.claims.project_id`. Propose adding `effective_owner` to request context and events.

Alex: Quick proposal: add `effective_owner` in request headers and as span tags, update billing pipeline to accept either owner or effective_owner with precedence to `effective_owner` if present. Need concrete schema + migration plan.

Sam: Concern: Console billing/usage pages expect project-level granularity. If we reattribute to pool owners customers will see sudden drops. Need gradual rollout + opt-in and visible preview.

Jen: @Sam +1. UX idea: Console shows attribution row with a tooltip: "origin: token_claim vs routed_owner" and a "preview attribution" toggle during rollout so customers can see effects before it changes billing.

Maria: Compatibility note: don't mutate existing fields. Add `attribution.v2.owner` and `attribution.v2.source` instead of replacing keys. Example event snippet: ```json
{\"attribution\": {\"v2\": {\"owner\":\"org:123\",\"source\":\"routing_hint\"}}}
```

Alex: Also need RBAC guardrails: service-account tokens should opt into `route_affinity` claim. Could be a boolean claim `route_affinity:true` so only intentional tokens get reattributed.

PlatformBot: Spec draft: https://redwood.internal/specs/token-attribution (v1.2) — added field names and telemetry test matrix.

Sam: Operational item: add an alert for delta between usage_by_token and usage_by_effective_owner > 5% during canary. Also add per-route telemetry to spot hotspots when routing shifts.

DeployBot: Canary started: rolling `routing-affinity` header to 2% -> 5% -> 20% across hosted fleet. Monitor dashboards @eng-sre.

Jen: I'll mock Console preview screens and post in #design tomorrow morning.

Alex: Action items: Maria open spec PR; Sam create alert runbook and graphs; Jen post mockups; infra to add header + unit tests. Thanks :thumbsup:
